S1_objective.description: Estimate where LQR recovery remains successful as a function of (a) the error state at the moment of the MPC->LQR switch, which tests LQR's small-error linear-model assumption, and (b) how strongly the first LQR commands are clipped by the steering angle and steering-rate limits.
S1_objective.question_ko: 전환 순간 차가 경로에서 얼마나 벗어나 있으면(오차 상태), 그리고 LQR 명령이 조향각·조향속도 한계에 얼마나 걸리면, LQR이 차선 안에서 복구하지 못하는가?
